summary: Inspected all 108 forward/reverse pairs on nine contact sheets. A roadside form/contact priority is consistently supported. B candidates occur where substantial upper or opposing rock faces and large slopes are readable; thin distant ridges alone do not qualify. C present is reserved for a visually separate coastal ridge or rocky projection beyond the near cut. B-face silhouettes remain protected within B and do not independently establish C; many apparent panoramas are therefore uncertain because their crest may belong to the same B massif or receding A slope. Sea pixels alone do not establish C. Near-side fields refer to clearly raised roadside forms, excluding flat shoulder strips; they describe each camera view and do not identify a shared physical surface. Absence applies only to the two sampled views. Diagnostic colours are not material classes. No geometry defects, D zones, hidden-world extents or confirmed simplification eligibility are asserted. AI proposals require owner review; canonical labels remain blank.
